continuity.arc_goal: Implement linked workflows MVP — parent-to-child workflow links with completion blocking, cross-partition cancellation, and observable state graphs. Success = end-to-end integration test passes with full create/complete/cancel/remove flow.

progress_update.summary: We implemented all 3 phases of the linked workflows MVP. Phase 1 (link table + CreateLink), Phase 2 (Completing variant + LinkCompletionNotification + completion path), and Phase 3 (RemoveLinkCommand + cancel propagation through links) are all committed with 5 passing integration tests. Code review between Phase 2 and 3 caught a VO parent bug and design simplification (remove label, key by child_service_id). All review findings addressed. MVP feature is functionally complete.
progress_update.goal: Implement linked workflows MVP with cross-partition support. Success = parent workflow starts linked child, child blocks parent completion, cancellation propagates through link tree, RemoveLink orphans child, end-to-end integration test passes.
accomplished: Completed all 3 implementation phases — 5 commits on linked-workflows branch
Phase 1: Link table storage stack, CreateLink journal entry, Link response sink variant
Phase 2: InvocationStatus::Completing variant (~25 match sites), LinkCompletionNotification outbox/command wiring, completion path, happy path tests (4 tests)
Phase 3: RemoveLinkCommand journal entry, cancel propagation through links for both Invoked/Suspended/Paused and Completing states, unhappy path test
Code review: fixed workflow-only Completing guard, refactored links to key by child_service_id (removed label), extracted transition_completing_to_completed helper
progress_update.now: All 3 waves complete, 5 tests passing. About to run code review on Wave 3, then MVP is done.
next_steps: Code review on Phase 3 (RemoveLink + cancel propagation)
Consider squashing/cleaning commit history if desired
Deferred items: HandlerInvocation sink (onCompleted), graph traversal API, orphan GC, SDK implementation
constraints: Cross-partition links from day one — all link operations use outbox messages
Only workflows can enter Completing — VOs complete immediately regardless of links
Links keyed by (parent_service_id, child_service_id) — no label field
No child_invocation_id — entity-to-entity links, restart-as-new disallowed on linked workflows
RemoveLinkCommand cannot trigger Completing→Completed via journal entry (journal entries only dispatched for Invoked/Suspended/Paused)
decisions: Removed label field entirely — links identified by child_service_id, not arbitrary label string
Cancel on Completing propagates to children via outbox InvocationTermination (replaced AlreadyCompleted return)
Extracted transition_completing_to_completed helper to avoid duplicated completion logic
No active_children_count — query link table for Running links instead of maintaining denormalized counter
Completion delivers Result<T, E> only — no status field, no inline frozen graph
Completing variant carries InFlightInvocationMetadata + buffered ResponseResult
RemoveLink included in MVP — graph curation is load-bearing
End-to-end integration test included in MVP scope
Cancellation is local per node — each node cancels its own direct children
Defer HandlerInvocation sink / onCompleted to post-MVP
open_questions: RemoveLinkCommand cannot fire during Completing state — is this acceptable or does it need a non-journal path?
CreateLink/RemoveLink codec stubs in service-protocol-v4 are unimplemented — needs SDK-side work
Graph traversal API — how does a parent inspect the frozen state graph of completed children? (deferred)
Orphan GC policy — default timeout for orphaned workflows? (deferred)
risks: Service protocol v4 codec for CreateLink/RemoveLink has unimplemented!() stubs — will panic if SDK sends these entries before codec is implemented
Cancel propagation uses InvocationQuery::Workflow to derive child InvocationId — assumes single active invocation per workflow ServiceId
